abi: function approve(address token, address spender, uint256 amount, uint256 deadline) external
function allowance(address user, address token, address spender) external view returns (uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)
function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256)
function permitTransferFrom(tuple(address token, uint256 amount) details, tuple(address spender, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline) spenderPermit, address owner, bytes signature) external
function permitBatch(address[] tokens, uint256[] values, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external
function permitToken(address token, address owner, address spender, uint256 amount, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external
event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed token, address indexed spender, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration)
event Permit(address indexed owner, address indexed token, address indexed spender, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)
event NonceInvalidation(address indexed owner, address indexed token, address indexed spender, uint48 newNonce, uint48 oldNonce)
event UnorderedNonceInvalidation(address indexed owner, uint256 word, uint256 mask)
